plugins.name: gamedev-lanes
plugins.description: Lane-scoped agent roster and orchestration rules for running a game project with AI agents: engineer, writer, graphics, art-director, sound, game-design, tester, devops, infrastructure, pm. Scaffolds a project's own documents — orientation doc, constitution, decision log, art, audio, voice and progression specs — and a reference cloud platform with free-tier hosting, player sign-in, storage and keyless CI/CD.
